description: This source file defines the AssetRepository class in C# for a data access layer interacting with a PostgreSQL database. It contains CRUD operations, existence checks, and management of related child resource data for assets, including classes like asset status logs, additional asset IDs, asset properties, control device mappings, input parameters, parent input mappings, reporting attribute mappings, and more. The repository pattern and asynchronous programming practices are prominently used.
